# LayerAI Docs

> LayerAI is a local-first browser extension for web content collection, AI translation, glossary governance, and cloud collaboration.

## Site

- Docs (zh): https://sovitech.mintlify.app/zh
- Docs (en): https://sovitech.mintlify.app/en
- MCP: https://sovitech.mintlify.app/mcp
- GitHub: https://github.com/houguang/layerai-docs

## Quick links

- [Introduction (zh)](https://sovitech.mintlify.app/zh/introduction)
- [Introduction (en)](https://sovitech.mintlify.app/en/introduction)
- [Install](https://sovitech.mintlify.app/zh/quickstart/install)
- [First translation](https://sovitech.mintlify.app/en/quickstart/first-translation)

## Structure

Content lives under `zh/` and `en/` with mirrored navigation in `docs.json`.
